loss_reduction: mean of 8 virtual-rank token means, each rank has 32 samples; weight microbatch loss by supervised-token-count within rank
precision: BF16 autocast; upstream PEFT adapter parameter dtype retained
lora_targets: unchanged upstream get_specific_layer_names: Linear, Embedding, Conv2d, Conv1D
source_replay: existing official XP-900 mixture, including its IIWA/Kinova3/UR5e demonstrations; no new source data; UR5e is the physical source evaluation robot
target: existing Panda target_50, two directions x 50 demonstrations
split: unchanged previously frozen episode-level baseline split: target 45 train + 5 validation per task; source 90%/10% per robot/task
normalization: reuse original mg_pnp_lite prior statistics for source and target; no fitting on held-out target episodes
tokenizer: original xp_900_pnp_action_tokenizer, original prior VQ, 8-action chunks
image: official 224px RGB preprocessing, single third-person image, no wrist image, no augmentation
joint_auxiliary_objective: unchanged official joint_reps transforms and weights
validation_target: fixed 32 uniformly spaced frames from each of 10 held-out Panda episodes, 320 total
validation_source: fixed 4 uniformly spaced frames from each of 60 held-out UR5e episodes, 240 total; diagnostic only
checkpoint_selection: lowest macro task teacher-forced Panda action-response NLL among trained steps 500,1000,1500,2000,2500,3000; ties choose earlier step; step 0 reference excluded
early_stopping: none based on validation or test performance; complete prescribed updates; abort on nonfinite loss/gradient, OOM, data mismatch, disk floor, or frozen wall cap
new_physical_evaluation: only the validation-selected new checkpoint, same saved 60-99 conditions, two tasks x two robots x 40 = 160 new rollouts
official_recipe_differences: Official paper reference is full-parameter multi-GPU training. This run uses the released official LoRA route because the existing real full-parameter batch-1 probe OOMed on this 24GB GPU.
Upstream VLA loop explicitly rejects accumulation. A separately tested accumulation loop is used; single-GPU arithmetic is not claimed bitwise identical to eight-GPU FSDP.
Hold out whole demonstrations using the existing task/robot stratified 90/10 split rather than the upstream default 95/5 TFDS ordering.
Checkpoint selection uses fixed offline validation only, not the paper's best physical score among three checkpoints.
Original and old adapters' target validation exposure differs: P3 trained on all 100 target episodes; old-adapter validation is descriptive, not clean held-out generalization.
